profile_exclusions.reason: Only Boolean, BigInt, DoublePrecision, Text, Bytea and Uuid metadata are represented; PostgreSQL narrow integers, numeric, typmods, domains and collations are not erased into them.
Only lower(text), upper(text), abs(bigint|double precision), optionally pg_catalog-qualified, are supported. Unknown, aggregate and DISTINCT calls are rejected.

The unchanged owned parser represents DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP/INTERVAL typed string syntax, whose types this binder rejects. Six-scalar literals use existing ::type syntax; CAST(expr AS type) and multiword cast syntax remain parser exclusions.
Numeric unary operators require a known numeric type; concatenation requires Text operands; modulo requires Int64. Wider PostgreSQL overloads and additional syntax remain outside this profile.
Validation proves metadata and expression consistency only; it does not verify source rows, key uniqueness, catalog publication or DDL execution.
